meanOverallChange[<=22].note: Mean overall change through one development step for players aged <=22 (age before).

meanOverallChange[23-26].note: Mean overall change through one development step for players aged 23-26 (age before).

meanOverallChange[27-30].note: Mean overall change through one development step for players aged 27-30 (age before).

meanOverallChange[31-33].note: Mean overall change through one development step for players aged 31-33 (age before).

meanOverallChange[34+].note: Mean overall change through one development step for players aged 34+ (age before).

shareGain3Plus.note: Share of developing players with overall change >= +3.

shareLose3Plus.note: Share of developing players with overall change <= -3.

shareGainAtCap.note: Share of developing players at exactly +5 (the annual cap).

shareLoseAtCap.note: Share of developing players at exactly -5 (the annual cap).

overall90Plus[first].note: Players with overall >= 90 at the first preseason start.

overall90Plus[last].note: Players with overall >= 90 at the last preseason start.

overall90Plus[max].note: Most players with overall >= 90 at any preseason start.

unsignedAtPreseason.note: Free agents in the pool at the start of preseason.preparation.

unsignedAtPreseason60Plus.note: Free agents with overall >= 60 in the pool at the start of preseason.preparation.

meanSalaryByTier[60-69].note: Mean new-season salary of players signed from the pool in free agency, overall 60-69. Sparse: a seed with no signing in this tier measures nothing, so a run without one is skipped, not failed.

meanSalaryByTier[70-79].note: Mean new-season salary of players signed from the pool in free agency, overall 70-79. Sparse: a seed with no signing in this tier measures nothing, so a run without one is skipped, not failed.

meanSalaryByTier[80+].note: Mean new-season salary of players signed from the pool in free agency, overall 80+. Sparse: a seed with no signing in this tier measures nothing, so a run without one is skipped, not failed.

topFaSignsWithHighestPayroll.note: Offseasons where the best free agent signed with the team that had the league's highest payroll at free_agency start (of offseasons where he signed).

starMaxOnOneTeam.note: Most players with overall >= 80 on one team at preseason start (mean over seasons).

starTop4TeamsShare.note: Share of players with overall >= 80 held by the four teams holding the most, at preseason start (an even spread over 12 teams is 0.33).

meanRosterTurnover.note: Per team, share of the previous preseason-start roster not on the same team at the next preseason start.

payrollWinPctCorrelation.note: Pearson r of payroll and regular-season win % across team-seasons (per seed, then averaged).

insolvencyRate.note: Share of team-seasons with business funds below 0 at postseason.season_review.

meanCashAfterOffseason.note: Mean team business funds at the start of preseason.preparation.

meanPayroll.note: Mean team payroll for the season at postseason.season_review.

meanRookieOverall[1-3].note: Mean overall, when drafted, of overall picks 1-3.

meanRookieOverall[4-8].note: Mean overall, when drafted, of overall picks 4-8.

meanRookieOverall[9-14].note: Mean overall, when drafted, of overall picks 9-14.

meanRookieOverall[15-24].note: Mean overall, when drafted, of overall picks 15-24.

shareTop5PicksStarters.note: Share of overall picks 1-5 still on the drafting team and in its top 5 by overall at the next preseason start.
